product_metadata.title: ZYER Glass Pie Plate Round Glass Pie Pan for Baking Pie Baking Pan Glass Pie Dish, 9.5 Inch
features: Healthier Choice Than Metal Bakeware: ZYER glass pie plate is made from tempered glass. Non-porous surface does not absorb food odors, flavors or stains. The non-stick interior with classic fishbone pattern adds a special touch of elegance and vitality to your pie.
Easy Grab with Handles: Glass pie pan lets you monitor baking and keep an eye on the bottom crust. Easy Grip petal shaped handles allow it to be easily moved without sticking your thumb in the pie.
Dimensions: 9-1/2 inch opening diameter. 8-1/4 inch bottom diameter. 1-4/5 inch deep. Just the right bakeware for Thanksgiving, Christmas, and other holiday pies.

Multifunctional: The 9.5 in pie plate is suitable for pumpkin pie, shepards pie, apple pie, blueberry pie or pecan pie, also it can be as a baking dish for quiche or serving plate for vegetables. Satisfy all kinds of need.

Microwave, Oven, Freezer, Dishwasher Safe: This mini pie pan is oven safe up to 482°F. Dishwasher safe for quick, easy cleanup. It can be transited directly from freezer to oven without the risk of cracking or shattering.
